answer_1.quote: We evaluate them on two widely-studied knowledge-intensive tasks: open-domain QA and knowledge-grounded dialogue.

answer_2.quote: CONNER is designed to be a reference-free framework that can systematically and automatically evaluate the generated knowledge from six fine-grained perspectives.
